PANORAMA PDAC Thesis — Progress Report¶

This notebook summarizes the work completed so far on the trustworthiness evaluation thesis, and closes with a request to extend the modeling approach from the originally proposed 2D / 2.5D transfer-learning pipeline to a full 3D volumetric approach.

Covered here: dataset composition, preprocessing pipeline (before / after), segmentation labels, data-quality checks, and the finalized patient-level train / validation / test split.

Not covered here: every intermediate audit cell — only the checks that matter for judging whether the dataset is ready for model training. The full audit trail exists in the earlier notebooks (dataset audit, patient-level split) for reference if needed.

# CELL 1 — IMPORTS AND PATHS
# ============================================================

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import SimpleITK as sitk

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Project paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(r"D:\Pancreatic_Cancer_Thesis")

DATA_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "data"
RAW_CT_DIR = DATA_DIR / "raw_ct"
PROCESSED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "processed"
IMAGES_DIR = PROCESSED_DIR / "images"
MASKS_DIR = PROCESSED_DIR / "masks"
METADATA_PATH = PROCESSED_DIR / "metadata.csv"
SPLIT_PATH = PROCESSED_DIR / "split_assignment.csv"

# A known problematic case from the batch 2 anomaly investigation.
# Excluded when picking a representative case for the before/after
# preprocessing visualization below.
EXCLUDED_DEMO_CASE = "100936_00001"

print("=" * 70)
print("PANORAMA PDAC THESIS — PROGRESS REPORT")
print("=" * 70)

print("\nProject root:", PROJECT_ROOT)
print("Metadata     :", METADATA_PATH)
print("Split file   :", SPLIT_PATH)

# ============================================================
# CELL 3 — DIAGNOSIS DISTRIBUTION (SINGLE VISUAL)
# ============================================================

counts = metadata["diagnosis"].value_counts()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4.5))
bars = ax.bar(counts.index, counts.values, color=["#4C72B0", "#DD8452"])

for bar, value in zip(bars, counts.values):
    pct = value / len(metadata) * 100
    ax.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        bar.get_height() + 15,
        f"{value}\n({pct:.1f}%)",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
    )

ax.set_ylabel("Number of cases")
ax.set_title("PANORAMA processed dataset composition")
ax.set_ylim(0, max(counts.values) * 1.2)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ============================================================
# CELL 5 — SELECT A REPRESENTATIVE CASE FOR VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================

processed_ids = set(metadata["study_id"].astype(str))
raw_ct_files = sorted(RAW_CT_DIR.glob("*_0000.nii.gz"))

representative_id = None

for path in raw_ct_files:
    study_id = path.name.replace("_0000.nii.gz", "")
    if study_id != EXCLUDED_DEMO_CASE and study_id in processed_ids:
        representative_id = study_id
        break

if representative_id is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("No suitable case found for the before/after visualization.")

print("=" * 70)
print("REPRESENTATIVE CASE")
print("=" * 70)
print("Study ID:", representative_id)

# ============================================================
# CELL 6 — BEFORE / AFTER PREPROCESSING
# ============================================================

raw_ct_path = RAW_CT_DIR / f"{representative_id}_0000.nii.gz"
raw_ct = sitk.ReadImage(str(raw_ct_path))
raw_array = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(raw_ct)

processed_ct_path = IMAGES_DIR / f"{representative_id}.npy"
processed_array = np.load(processed_ct_path, mmap_mode="r")

HU_MIN, HU_MAX = -150, 250

raw_slice = raw_array[raw_array.shape[0] // 2]
raw_display = np.clip(raw_slice, HU_MIN, HU_MAX)
raw_display = (raw_display - HU_MIN) / (HU_MAX - HU_MIN)

processed_slice = processed_array[processed_array.shape[0] // 2]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

axes[0].imshow(raw_display, cmap="gray")
axes[0].set_title(f"Original CT\n{representative_id}\nsize={raw_ct.GetSize()}")
axes[0].axis("off")

axes[1].imshow(processed_slice, cmap="gray")
axes[1].set_title(f"After preprocessing\nshape={processed_array.shape}")
axes[1].axis("off")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# CELL 8 — DATA QUALITY CHECKS

missing_images = sum(
    1 for sid in metadata["study_id"].astype(str)
    if not (IMAGES_DIR / f"{sid}.npy").exists()
)
missing_masks = sum(
    1 for sid in metadata["study_id"].astype(str)
    if not (MASKS_DIR / f"{sid}.npy").exists()
)
duplicate_studies = int(metadata["study_id"].duplicated().sum())

qc_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Check": [
        "Processed cases",
        "Missing processed images",
        "Missing processed masks",
        "Duplicate study IDs",
    ],
    "Result": [
        len(metadata),
        missing_images,
        missing_masks,
        duplicate_studies,
    ],
})

print("=" * 70)

print("=" * 70)

display(qc_summary)

# ============================================================
# CELL 9 — PATIENT-LEVEL SPLIT SUMMARY
# ============================================================

if not SPLIT_PATH.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Split file not found:\n{SPLIT_PATH}")

split_df = pd.read_csv(SPLIT_PATH)

split_counts = split_df["split"].value_counts().reindex(["train", "validation", "test"])
diagnosis_pct = (
    pd.crosstab(split_df["split"], split_df["diagnosis"], normalize="index")
    .mul(100).round(1)
    .reindex(["train", "validation", "test"])
)

split_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Split": split_counts.index,
    "Cases": split_counts.values,
    "PDAC %": diagnosis_pct["PDAC"].values,
})

print("=" * 70)
print("PATIENT-LEVEL TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST SPLIT")
print("=" * 70)

display(split_summary)

# Leakage check: no patient should appear in more than one split.
patient_split_count = split_df.groupby("patient_id")["split"].nunique()
leaking_patients = patient_split_count[patient_split_count > 1]

multi_case_patients = metadata.groupby("patient_id").size()
multi_case_patients = multi_case_patients[multi_case_patients > 1]

print(f"\nPatients with multiple CT studies : {len(multi_case_patients)} "
      f"(max {multi_case_patients.max()} studies for one patient)")
print(f"Patients split across more than one set : {len(leaking_patients)}")

assert len(leaking_patients) == 0
assert split_df["study_id"].is_unique
assert len(split_df) == len(metadata)

print("\n\u2713 Split is patient-level safe: no patient appears in more than one set.")
